name: Grounded AI that advances people's goals
vision_statement: Goals keep moving between a person's sessions, because the work they delegated gets done to the standard they wrote, and every answer and action rests on the person's own goals, material and preferences, and never on another person's.
opportunities: unconfirmed: for Joshua to confirm. Other products that need an AI which works from a person's own goals and material could reuse this engine, so the grounding, the standard for delegated work and the scope fences are built once and shared.
solution_coherence: quest-ai-runner turns a person's request or queued task into grounded work in one loop, and do-grounded-work is that loop. do-grounded-work takes a request in through talk-over-a-channel, operate-from-a-terminal, receive-input-mid-run and run-queued-tasks, hands it to route-a-message, and answers chat turns through answer-a-turn. It grounds the answer in the person's own material through select-context, gather-evidence, remember-conversations, recall-recent-context, resolve-references and cache-cards, with persist-cards and index-by-meaning keeping the cards, and it keeps the prompt in order through assemble-a-prompt and the model choice through call-a-model, choose-a-model-tier and track-usage-and-cost. It does the work through operate-a-quest, write-files, write-through-mcp and run-deep-work, watches it through watch-for-risk and detect-a-stalled-run, settles narrow questions through judge-a-decision, stops unsafe replies through guard-a-reply, and brings a step only a person may take to that person through escalate-to-a-human. It shows what it is doing through show-progress, learns from corrections through guide-by-feedback and store-feedback, and replays what worked through replay-known-operations. It keeps itself measurable and open through keep-it-generic, select-an-implementation, configure-a-lane, verify-offline, keep-secrets-out, behave-by-esoi and judge-esoi-behavior, and it is offered to others through expose-the-public-api, learn-by-example and explain-qar. The specification of the loop is spread over named areas. reason-and-answer is the mind, one goal-focused stream per request, and remember-and-recall is the subconscious that admits the person's own cards into it, with card-store holding them, bound-card-growth and repair-a-card-store keeping the store from inflating, choose-what-to-index choosing what deserves a card, label-context-cards and detect-stale-cards keeping them honest, and search-cards-and-specs searching cards and specifications together. know-the-world answers questions about the world through search-the-web. think-critically holds deep runs to their metric through iterate-by-spec, spec-selection, ground-in-intent, draft-a-metric and gate-an-autopilot-pass, and core-ml-tasks, answer-end-to-end and tag-solutions measure the classifiers, the whole turn and the reach of a change. act-as-the-body does the work and claim-reach claims only the reach it has, while use-open-source-hubs prefers a standard hub to a bespoke integration and access-quest-operations reaches Quest's operations. hold-the-intents keeps the standing view of a representative across turns, select-a-rep picks the representative, hand-off-a-goal decides who owns a new goal, and guide-toward-the-long-term-goal keeps work aimed at the person's end, with persist-predictions saving what was learned. The person is kept informed through reply-in-steps, ask-on-block, narrate-a-turn, show-the-ais-work, explain-an-answer, describe-an-attachment and assist-a-terminal-session, and feed-context-sources adds what changed in a work item, while justify-model-calls accounts for every model call.
